France Faces Widespread School Protests and Arrests

High school protests have spread across France, marked by school blockades, fires, and clashes with police. Hundreds of arrests have been made amid the escalating unrest. One report indicated that a crisis meeting was informed that France's hard-left party was behind the school protests, according to a source. Unions also staged a day of protests.
